usage: Used to indicate that two or more things are the same or alike
Often appears in comparisons to emphasise similarity
Commonly used in everyday spoken Cantonese

examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 ge3 soeng2 faat3 jat1 joeng6
ni1 loeng5 gin6 saam1 jat1 joeng6 gwai3
examples.meaning: These two clothes are equally expensive.
